name: kasbah-guard-monorepo
description: Kasbah Guard — Full-stack secret detection ecosystem

scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:static
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:market && npm run test:js && npm run test:cli
scripts.test:market: node /tmp/kasbah-market-launch.cjs 2>/dev/null || echo '⚠️ Market launch tests skipped (requires /tmp)'
scripts.test:cli: /tmp/kasbah-cli-build/release/kasbah selftest 2>/dev/null || echo '⚠️ CLI tests skipped (requires build)'
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && rm -rf node_modules dist build

author: Kasbah Guard <team@bekasbah.com>
